description: This PHP source file defines a migration class for version 3.3.3 of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to execute SQL scripts during a database migration and overrides a method to specify its version.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class extending AbstractMigration to implement specific migration steps for version 3.3.3 of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the database scripts dbscript-1.sql and dbscript-2.sql to perform the migration steps.

methods.name: execQueries
methods.description: Reads a SQL script file, splits it into individual statements, and executes each statement using the database connection.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '3.3.3' associated with this migration.
